name: Lake Natoma
subtitle: Lake Natoma above Nimbus Dam. Releases from Folsom Dam can change the current.

course.note: Estimate along the lake from the aquatic center. Not checked on the water.

copy.description: Go, caution or stay off: rowing conditions on Lake Natoma, Gold River, CA.
copy.credits: Forecast from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/). Alerts and Mather airport observations from the [National Weather Service, Sacramento](https://www.weather.gov/sto/). Water temperature from USGS gauge [11446500 at Fair Oaks](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-11446500/). Air quality from Open-Meteo (Copernicus CAMS), and the model comparison from GFS, ECMWF, GEM and ICON via Open-Meteo.

sources.label: Mather
sources.note: Mather airport, 6 mi southwest. A check on the model.

sources.label: Fair Oaks
sources.note: USGS gauge on the American River just below Nimbus Dam, about 0.5 mi west. It measures water leaving the lake.
